sources.publicWarning: Board payment disclosures are not annual salary rates or an employee roster. The named remuneration column is remuneration; the expenses column is separate. The source name cell, including any Chair suffix, is retained literally; no separate position column is published. Source expense blanks and dashes stay unknown (null); no printed amount is adjusted to balance a subtotal. 7 named board observation(s) with nonnumeric remuneration are held as supporting evidence rather than assigned zero pay. Imported numeric-pay rows carry 4046 CAD in known expenses; excluded nonnumeric-pay rows carry 2404 CAD. The full named-board expense control includes both subsets. The Legislative Library archival copy includes an added catalogue cover. All dash-only remuneration observations remain supporting research, with their expenses retained for the full Board control; no zero remuneration is invented. The source notes that remuneration excludes fees paid in the next fiscal year. Existing compiled observations are retained and may overlap this official schedule; no identity or reporting-period equivalence is assumed.
notes: The named remuneration column is remuneration; the expenses column is separate. The source name cell, including any Chair suffix, is retained literally; no separate position column is published.
Names retain the source spelling; adjacent footnote markers are separately preserved in row provenance.
Source footnotes may describe payments for meetings or travel from earlier years; observations retain the internally stated payment disclosure year.
